signature.name: Pitch gauge ruler
signature.summary: a ruler that measures roof pitch along each section

signature.name: Botanical Plant Marker
signature.summary: An embossed tag primitive with common name, Latin italic, and location/light line; appears as hero label, service cards, review tags, and footer area pills.

signature.name: Ledger line + percent column
signature.summary: A thin ruled line separates each section like a row on a cost sheet; a vertical percent column on the right edge shows that section's share of budget; a running total accumulates to 100% at the footer.

sites.paletteFamily: Ledger cream + ink blue + signal red

signature.name: Coat Schedule Stripe
signature.summary: Left-edge vertical stripe representing cumulative film build; each section adds one translucent layer, numbered 00-06 with dry-time stamps. Stripe thickens via --sw-p scroll variable.

signature.name: Zone Schedule
signature.summary: A horizontal rule with a zone tag (Z1, Z2...), a mono run-time pill, and a gallons-per-week readout that counts up on scroll. Reused in hero, services, reviews, and footer.

signature.name: Contour bands with elevation tags
signature.summary: Horizontal rust contour lines divide sections; each carries an elevation tag in mono type. Content organizes by altitude: river (water repair), mid-slope (porches/kitchens), steep (ADUs/retaining), ridge (service area). Elevation counter climbs on scroll.

signature.name: Time Card Punch
signature.summary: A vertical time rail with monospaced timestamp pills that ink in as you scroll; the footer is the 12:00 punch-out stamp.

signature.name: Facade + Plaque
signature.summary: A simplified Charleston house silhouette with a fill color set via CSS custom property, and a small rectangular plaque beneath it containing street-feeling, enemy, and service lines in mono accent type. Reused across hero filmstrip, four story sections, and footer rule.

signature.name: Tint Ticket + Drawdown Bar
signature.summary: A tint ticket label caps each section with service data; a drawdown bar animates across as a colored rule whose width or opacity reflects coverage or rating.

signature.name: One-Line Diagram Trace
signature.summary: A 2px copper vertical rule with electrical symbol nodes at each section boundary; the line draws on scroll and nodes light from chalk to copper as sections enter view.

signature.name: Brass Valve Tags on Pipe Rail
signature.summary: A horizontal copper-colored rule tops every section; numbered brass tags hang from it marking visit steps (01-06), services (price ranges), reviews (stars), and footer (initials). Tags swing in on scroll; rail fills via --sw-p.

signature.name: Pegboard Hang-Tag
signature.summary: A CSS primitive: 1px peg-hole grid background + tool-outline SVG with a hang-tag pill showing hours or price; lifts off the wall when added to the list.

signature.name: Room Marker + Arch Frame
signature.summary: A Tudor-arch clip-path frames photos and dividers; a circular room marker with a brass connector line tracks progress through the house. Markers fill on scroll; the arch repeats as structural frame.

signature.name: Ledger Rule + Status Stamp
signature.summary: A horizontal steel-blue rule underlines every section like a line on a graph-paper field book; each entry row carries an entry number in mono, a measurement or reading, a status stamp pill (OK · WATCH · FIX) and the action verb. The rule animates on scroll via --sw-p clip-path wipe.

signature.name: Department Masthead + Page-Number Rail
signature.summary: A thin lake-blue rule tops each section carrying the department name in small caps serif on the left and a mono page number (00-06) on the right; the rule draws left-to-right on scroll via --sw-p. Reused in hero masthead, five departments, and footer.

sites.paletteFamily: Lake Erie Blue + Furnace Red + Snow Paper

signature.name: Grit Sequence Rail
signature.summary: A horizontal rail carries the grit number (36 · 60 · 100 · STAIN · COAT 1 · 2 · 3) at each section top; noise texture grain matches the grit; rail draws left-to-right on scroll via --sw-p clip-path wipe.

sites.paletteFamily: Raw Maple + Walnut Ink + Finish Amber

signature.name: Sample Chip Cross-Section
signature.summary: A rectangular chip with a torn/cut left edge, a spec strip along the bottom (wear layer · thickness · core · water rating), and a tiny cross-section diagram that draws itself via --sw-p on scroll.

signature.name: crosstie track
signature.summary: horizontal tie bars with stenciled week numbers and Friday report cards, connected by two steel rails and an advancing amber today-line

signature.name: Carbon-Copy Pour Ticket
signature.summary: A dashed-left-border ticket line with a carbon-blue offset copy that pulls away on hover; step numbers in mono; a right-margin 28-day strength curve advances via --sw-p. Reused in hero, process story, reviews, tools, form and footer.

sites.paletteFamily: Ticket Paper + Carbon Blue + Safety Orange

signature.name: Street Sign Marker
signature.summary: Vertical post with hanging blade sign carrying neighborhood name in slab serif and house type in mono. Brass accent border. Organizes content by place, not service category.

signature.name: Spec Rail + Dimension Callout
signature.summary: A sticky right rail (bottom sheet on phones) titled 'Your slab' accumulates choices from tools and dimension-line callouts; each section ends with a .dim-line primitive (arrowheads + value) that can be added to the spec. The rail expands into the quote form. Reused in hero, core-sample story, tools, reviews and footer.

signature.name: Depth gauge + horizon bands
signature.summary: A vertical depth gauge runs down the left edge with inch marks; each section is a soil horizon with its depth tag, wavy earth-tone divider, and the job step done at that depth. Footer is bedrock.

signature.name: Tide Line Gauge
signature.summary: A thin horizontal rule with a left-aligned height tag (e.g. KING TIDE 3.8 ft) that moves vertically between sections like a harbour gauge; each instance carries a measurement teaching the floor-water relationship.

sites.paletteFamily: Tide Navy + Heart Pine Amber + Sand Paper

signature.name: Contour Line + Elevation Marker
signature.summary: Soft terracotta contour SVG pattern behind every section; elevation-marker trail-sign pill on each header; corner elevation counter climbs via --sw-p; benchmark triangle on every photo caption; town-pin mini-map in proof.

signature.name: Mortar Joint Progression
signature.summary: Horizontal divider drawn as two brick courses with a mortar gap whose profile advances through repointing stages (raked → packed → struck → tooled → concave); animates via --sw-p; data-sw-signature hook.

sites.paletteFamily: Lime Cream + Soft Brick + Iron Ink

signature.name: Layer Gauge
signature.summary: Vertical margin rail listing seven wall layers (Paint·Plaster·Lath·Insulation·Wiring·Plumbing·Studs); each page section maps to one layer and illuminates its row on scroll via --sw-p; reused in hero, process story, service chips, reviews and footer.

signature.name: Flemish-Bond Test Panel Grid
signature.summary: A CSS grid alternating header-tile and stretcher-tile widths with mortar-colored gutters; numbers in headers, copy/photos in stretchers. Reused in hero mosaic, proof band, service cards, and footer.

signature.name: Story Pole Ruler
signature.summary: A vertical graphite ruler in the left margin with tick marks at real rowhouse heights (0-132 in); active tick highlights in pencil-mark orange on scroll; dimension callouts, service height tags, tool readouts and review tolerance pills all align to the same scale.

signature.name: Cut List + Kerf Rule
signature.summary: Horizontal dimension-line primitive with left/right ticks and mono label 'CUT NN · PART · DIMS · SPECIES'; kerf width grows via --sw-p; reused in hero, rot story, trim cards, footer.

sites.paletteFamily: Harbor Teal + Clapboard Cream + Oxide Red + Brass

signature.name: Visit Timeline Tick
signature.summary: Vertical timeline rail with mono timestamps; pencil-stroke tick SVG draws beside checklist items as sections enter view via --sw-p. Reused in hero, process story, reviews, and footer.

signature.name: Ticket Clock Rail
signature.summary: A 2px sage-green vertical rule with mono timestamp pills that light on scroll; pinned hero photo pans/crops per entry; sample-reading chips echo the format in proof.

sites.paletteFamily: Desert Charcoal + Saltbush Sage + Sodium Signal

signature.name: Maker's-Mark Stamp
signature.summary: A CSS-drawn brick face with a recessed frog stamp carrying a two-letter section code and number; presses in on scroll entry. Reused in hero, neighborhood cards, service cards, reviews, and footer.

signature.name: Reclaimed-Space Ruler
signature.summary: A vertical ruler line with sq-ft tick marks that grows on scroll; each section adds a job entry and the running total counts reclaimed yard space. Reused in hero, services, reviews, and footer.

sites.paletteFamily: Blue Ridge Pine + Dogwood Cream + Slate

signature.name: Perforated Weigh Ticket
signature.summary: A dashed-left-border ticket stub with carbon-teal offset copy, mono ticket number, date, load type and weight; accumulates tonnage in header via --sw-p.

sites.paletteFamily: Scale-Ticket Buff + Carbon Teal + Stamp Red

signature.name: Floor Band + Baluster Rule
signature.summary: Each section is a floor band topped by a repeating baluster-pattern SVG rule; a fixed triple-decker elevation drawing in the corner lights the active floor on scroll. Hook: data-sw-signature='floor-band'.

signature.name: Panel Schedule Flip
signature.summary: Two-column rail of numbered breaker slots with amperage pills and handwritten labels; handles flip OFF→ON on scroll entry, labels draw in via clip-path wipe. Reused in hero mosaic, service cards, review filing, and footer main-off slot.

sites.paletteFamily: Breaker Charcoal + Panel Cream + Amber ON
